description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pale pillow is in front, with a white charging cable and a smartphone lying near the center-right. The right hand reaches in from the right to pick up the phone and hold it up, while the left hand moves in from the left to grab the cable end and guide it into the phone’s charging port; then the right hand lowers the phone back onto the bed with the cable attached as the left hand lets go.
